setting: A fictional quick update between a team member and a team lead.

presentation.situation: You work on {{task}}. {{status}} The blocker is that {{blocker}}. {{name}}, your team lead, stops by for a quick update. Give the status, explain the blocker without blame, and commit to a next step.
presentation.opening: Can you give me a quick update on {{task}}?

brief.you_are: You are giving your team lead a quick status update.
brief.situation: You work on {{task}}. {{status}} The blocker is that {{blocker}}. {{name}}, your team lead, stops by for a quick update. Give the status, explain the blocker without blame, and commit to a next step.
brief.task: Lead with the current status, explain the blocker without blaming anyone, and commit to a next step.
brief.done_looks_like: {{name}} knows where things stand, what is blocking you, and what you will do next.

participants.name: You
participants.relationship: You are giving your team lead a quick status update.
goals: Lead with the current status, explain the blocker without blaming anyone, and commit to a next step.

card.want: A fast, honest status, without having to dig for it.
card.hidden_need: Needs to warn the client if the date moves.
card.speech: Clear everyday English. Natural, not formal.
tactics: Ask whose job the blocker is, if someone is blamed

pressure.gentle: Patient. Gives the other person time.
pressure.balanced: Pushes back once on anything vague.
pressure.challenging: Keeps pressing for specifics, fairly and without insults.

objectives.evidence: The learner opens with the current status.
alternatives: The current status is that it is about 80 percent finished.

objectives.evidence: The learner explains the blocker factually, without blaming a person.
alternatives: I'm waiting for the login details, so I can't test yet.

objectives.evidence: The learner commits to a specific next step.
alternatives: Next, I will chase them today and finish by Thursday.

beats.orient: I just need a quick update. Start with where things are now.
Tell me what is holding it up. Describe the problem, not the person.
Now tell me what you will do next, and by when. Start with: Next, I will.

closing_line: Okay, that's clear. Thanks for the update.

o1.good: Starting with the status, so your lead does not need to ask.
o1.model: The current status is that it is mostly done, with one thing open.

o2.good: Describing the situation, not who is at fault.
o2.micro_lesson: Say: I'm waiting for, or: The blocker is.
o2.model: The blocker is that I'm still waiting for the login details.

o3.good: A clear commitment, with a time.
o3.micro_lesson: Say: I will, and a day.
o3.model: Next, I will chase them today, and finish by Thursday.

variants.name: Sophie
variants.blocker: the finance figures have not arrived yet

variants.name: Kamal
variants.blocker: the test login does not work
